# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.6 R2 phases 1-4, Crimea and the northern shore. Generated by gen_crimea.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope. Calm enough for this line's events (design 3.2, as W5's oe_emd_calm): no civil war, no theme revolt, no
# Byzantine intrigue, and the author's Black Sea campaign is not running. World steps do not wait for it.
oe_crm_calm = {
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_active }
    oe_bi_active = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active }
}
# BYZ scope. Can pay $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_crm_can_pay = { gold >= { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }

# Country scope. The Genoese side (design 3.4): Genoa, Gazaria, or a subject of Genoa at any depth. Once Genoa has
# annexed Gazaria the land and the opinions fall to Genoa itself.
oe_crm_gen_side = { OR = { tag = GEN tag = GAZ AND = { country_exists = c:GEN is_subject_or_below_of = c:GEN } } }
# Location scope. The place is held by the steppe side (design 3.4): an AI owner that is not of the Genoese side, not
# Theodoro and not in the imperial bloc. It may be the Golden Horde or a Crimean state that arose by itself.
oe_crm_steppe_owner = {
    has_owner = yes
    owner = { is_ai = yes oe_crm_gen_side = no NOT = { tag = FEO } NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
}
# Location scope. An AI of the Genoese side holds the place.
oe_crm_gen_holds = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes oe_crm_gen_side = yes } }
# Location scope. Its owner is really at war with the owner of Caffa.
oe_crm_war_with_gz = {
    has_owner = yes
    location:kaffa = { has_owner = yes }
    owner = { is_at_war_with = location:kaffa.owner }
}
# Location scope. Its owner is in turmoil (k1, "趁大乱"): C4's great troubles are on, the owner has its own horde civil
# war or civil war, or the owner is no longer the Golden Horde.
oe_crm_owner_troubled = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_troubles global_var:oe_glh_troubles = 1 }
        owner = { OR = { in_civil_war = yes has_active_disaster = disaster_type:horde_civil_war NOT = { tag = GLH } } }
    }
}
# Location scope. A player owns it.
oe_crm_owner_player = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = no } }
# Any scope. The Gazarian half can still happen (design 3.2): Caffa has an AI owner of the Genoese side outside the
# imperial bloc, and no player plays Genoa or Gazaria.
oe_crm_g_pre = {
    location:kaffa = { has_owner = yes owner = { is_ai = yes oe_crm_gen_side = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    oe_crm_g_player = no
}
# Any scope. A player plays Genoa, Gazaria or the owner of Caffa.
oe_crm_g_player = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:GEN c:GEN = { is_ai = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GAZ c:GAZ = { is_ai = no } }
        location:kaffa = { oe_crm_owner_player = yes }
    }
}
# Any scope. The Theodoran half can still happen: Theodoro exists, is AI and Orthodox, is not in the imperial bloc and
# holds theodoro.
oe_crm_f_pre = {
    country_exists = c:FEO
    c:FEO = { is_ai = yes religion = religion:orthodox NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
    location:theodoro = { owner ?= c:FEO }
}
# Any scope. A player plays Theodoro.
oe_crm_f_player = { country_exists = c:FEO c:FEO = { is_ai = no } }
# BYZ scope (phase 4, k8 k9 k9m; design 3.2 oe_crm_ott_ok). The Ottomans exist, are AI and have not joined the empire
# through the house of Osman's restoration chain (BYZ oe_osman_chain_active). That they hold Constantinople is a timing
# condition (oe_crm_k8_when ...), which the test buttons leave out.
oe_crm_ott_ok = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { has_variable = oe_osman_chain_active } c:TUR = { is_ai = yes } }
# Any scope. The Ottomans hold Constantinople.
oe_crm_ott_city = { country_exists = c:TUR location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
# Any scope. A player plays the Ottomans.
oe_crm_ott_player = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = no } }
# Location scope. Its owner is at war with the Ottomans or their ally (k8, k9, k9m: then the steps give way, 3).
oe_crm_tur_tied = {
    has_owner = yes
    country_exists = c:TUR
    owner = { OR = { is_at_war_with = c:TUR is_allied_with = { target = c:TUR } } }
}
# Any scope. The later survival line N4 has not taken the fate of the Crimea over (global oe_n4_crimea). N4 does not exist
# yet: no file of the mod sets the name, so the read is not written and this is always true.
oe_crm_n4_free = { always = yes }

# Any scope. A world step ran (1), or its window passed without it (2: nothing stopped it but the conditions; 3: a

oe_crm_ran_k1 = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 global_var:oe_crm_ws_k1 = 1 }

# Soldaia went to the Genoese side in 1365 (k1) / with the coast in 1380-81 (k2).

# BYZ scope. Nothing of the Gazarian history has happened / of the Theodoran history.
oe_crm_g_none = { oe_crm_ran_k1 = no oe_crm_ran_k2 = no }
oe_crm_f_none = { oe_crm_ran_k4 = no oe_crm_ran_k5 = no oe_crm_ran_k6 = no NOT = { var:oe_crm_st_12 ?= 1 } NOT = { var:oe_crm_st_13 ?= 1 } }
# BYZ scope. The first part of the Gazarian history (1365-1387, the chronicle row crmg) is over: the three steps are on
# record, the Solkhat war is not being fought and both events are settled; in any case from 1391.7.1.
oe_crm_g_over = {
    OR = {
        current_date >= 1391.7.1
        AND = {
            has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k1 has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k2 has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k3
            oe_crm_solkhat_on = no
            has_variable = oe_crm_st_1 has_variable = oe_crm_st_2
        }
    }
}

oe_crm_f_over = { OR = { current_date >= 1434.10.1 has_global_variable = oe_crm_ws_k6 } }

# BYZ scope. When in its window a step comes (the test buttons leave these out, as they leave out the dates).
# k1: the steppe owner of soldaia is in turmoil (or the Genoese side holds it already). k2: after C4's Kulikovo (done or skipped), or from March 1381.
# k4: after C4's sack of Tana. k6: once the fleet event .13 has been answered or given up; in the last month of its
# window it runs anyway.
oe_crm_k1_when = { location:soldaia = { OR = { oe_crm_gen_holds = yes oe_crm_owner_troubled = yes } } }
oe_crm_k2_when = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_kulikovo current_date >= 1381.3.1 } }
oe_crm_k4_when = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_tana_ruined }
oe_crm_k6_when = { OR = { has_variable = oe_crm_st_13 var:oe_crm_m >= 1173 } }
# k7: vanilla's Black Death is active, and C4's embargo is over (the grain ships sail again) or it is September 1347.
# k8, k9, k9m: the Ottomans hold Constantinople (design 3.5: only in a world where the City has fallen).
oe_crm_k7_when = { disease_is_active = disease:bubonic_plague OR = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo_over current_date >= 1347.9.1 } }
oe_crm_k8_when = { oe_crm_ott_city = yes }
oe_crm_k9_when = { oe_crm_ott_city = yes }
oe_crm_k9m_when = { oe_crm_ott_city = yes }

# BYZ scope. The chronicle (gen_chronicle.py rows crmg and crmf, a hook in plan_20261117/v66/r2-crm12_实施.md). The
# chronicle tests void, then ended, then under way. Void: the half is void or the row is over, and nothing of it
# happened. Ended: the half is void or the row is over (something happened). Under way: from its first window, or once
# something has happened.
oe_crm_chr_g_void = { oe_crm_g_none = yes OR = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_g_void oe_crm_g_over = yes } }
oe_crm_chr_g_done = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_g_void oe_crm_g_over = yes } }
oe_crm_chr_g_run = { OR = { current_date >= 1365.7.1 oe_crm_g_none = no } }
oe_crm_chr_f_void = { oe_crm_f_none = yes OR = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_f_void oe_crm_f_over = yes } }
oe_crm_chr_f_done = { OR = { has_global_variable = oe_crm_f_void oe_crm_f_over = yes } }
oe_crm_chr_f_run = { OR = { current_date >= 1395.6.1 oe_crm_f_none = no } }
